name: Google Drive
summary: Use files you pick from Google Drive, and save assets and drafts back to it.

actions.name: List shared files
actions.description: Lists the Drive files the owner picked for Fless, or that Fless created.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Read a file
actions.description: Reads a picked file: text content for documents, or a Fless asset copy for images and video.

actions.name: Save a file to Drive
actions.description: Saves an image, video or document from Fless to Drive.

actions.name: Create a Google Doc
actions.description: Creates a new Google Doc with drafted content, for the owner to edit.
